profileContract.rationale: The plan must preserve server-authoritative rules, client presentation, optional integration isolation, and editor bundle boundaries.
Rule snapshot revision and player-relevant state must determine cached presence decisions and invalidation.

Reported defects and the promoted feature span performance, optional integration absence, editor serialization and data preservation, destination identity, item conservation, artifact drift, GUI depth, and release automation failure.
Fixes must work for integrated and dedicated servers, solo and mixed multiplayer ownership, and optional-mod combinations.
Stage files, commands, APIs, GUI, editor, destination-aware inventory transactions, optional integrations, and release artifacts are public product surfaces.
The current shared attestation verifier fails and must be repaired upstream before 3.0.4 publication.
Editor authority, client packets, optional reflection, release provenance, and no-secret handling remain mandatory.
Stage ownership, condition contexts, caches, server snapshots, and configuration must remain compatible.
Every issue and CORE-REQ-012 require focused regression evidence plus integrated, multiplayer, optional-mod, performance, editor-transaction, inventory-conservation, and artifact proof.
The endpoint is a compatible 3.0.4 patch without platform or schema upgrades.

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Freeze and reproduce or artifact-verify the six baseline reports, including stale tracking reports.
Repair entity-presence performance without changing multiplayer visibility, spawning, targeting, or lifecycle semantics.
Restore Curios slot gating with version-tolerant API resolution and absent-mod safety.
Make JEI and EMI independently configurable, optional, and simultaneously functional.
Verify or repair published Easy Builder enchantment controls in the production editor bundle and final JAR.
Verify or repair category menu depth in the in-game progression map without regressions to navigation and inspector behavior.
Implement any previously advertised 3.0.3 user-visible capability that the polish matrix proves missing from a shipped artifact.
Preserve supported configuration, stage schema, saved data, commands, APIs, and multiplayer compatibility.
Repair and prove the shared release attestation verifier for the 3.0.4 release artifact.
Build, integrate, attest, document, publish, and verify 3.0.4, then close the six baseline issues with evidence.
Correct the Easy Builder recipe-lock round trip so visual rules serialize, validate, persist, reload, compile, and enforce through the canonical recipes locked_items field without rule loss.

Add server-authoritative player-initiated inventory insertion locks with source-item and destination-inventory selectors, priority exceptions, complete Easy Builder and TOML round trips, and lossless transaction enforcement.

optionalFutureScope.summary: The legacy roadmap's unimplemented feature phases beyond advertised 3.0.3 behavior.
Dependabot pull request #19 unless it becomes security or compatibility blocking evidence.
New feature requests outside the six-issue audit baseline and the explicitly owner-promoted CORE-REQ-012 inventory insertion feature.
Minecraft, NeoForge, Java, Gradle, or mapping upgrades.

nonGoals.summary: No unscoped progression redesign, broad schema overhaul, or lock category beyond the bounded inventory-interaction extension in CORE-REQ-012.
No hard dependency on Curios, JEI, EMI, or another optional integration.
No full registry, stage, or entity scan in server tick or render hot paths.
No issue closure based only on source presence, prior release notes, or lower-fidelity checks.

ownerDecisions.question: Completion endpoint
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Publish ProgressiveStages 3.0.4 to CurseForge and Modrinth after verified master integration.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner selected a public patch release with verified integration

ownerDecisions.question: Mandatory scope boundary
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Implement previously advertised or documented 3.0.3 capability if a polish audit proves it missing. Exclude novel unpromised product features.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The polish matrix controls completeness without expanding the product roadmap

ownerDecisions.question: Recipe viewer operation
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: JEI and EMI have independent enabled settings, default enabled, and both work concurrently when installed.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Mixed client installations require independent optional viewer controls

ownerDecisions.question: Entity presence performance gate
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Use the approved per-player-per-tick context, no per-entity rebuild, under-five-percent sampled work, and at-most-ten-percent p95 MSPT regression thresholds.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The lag correction needs fixed correctness and performance limits

ownerDecisions.question: Shared workflow release gate
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Yes. Repair and verification of the shared attestation workflow are mandatory before 3.0.4 publication.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Release evidence must be verified by the supported shared workflow

ownerDecisions.question: Issue #25 inclusion
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Issue #25 is mandatory for 3.0.4 and increases the fixed issue baseline from five to six without changing the release endpoint.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner promoted the reported editor serialization defect into the current polish release before goal creation

ownerDecisions.question: Inventory insertion lock inclusion
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Add destination-aware player-initiated inventory insertion locks to 3.0.4. A rule selects both the item being inserted and the receiving block, menu, or inventory owner, uses the existing selector and priority system, and does not attribute playerless hopper or automation transfers to a nearby player.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Profession packs need to deny ore insertion into a selling bin, chest, furnace, or compatible modded container until the player owns the required stage, without item loss, duplication, or automation regressions.
